description: Tags and strict modes have effect: with no disk carrying the tag a strict rule names, in the domain it names, no disk takes the replica, a denied overflow sends it nowhere else, and the file is degraded.
config:
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]
mount = "${SANDBOX}/pool"
[[disk]]
id = "t1"
uuid = "3f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1"
fs = "ext4"
[[disk]]
id = "t2"
uuid = "7a2b4c6d-8e0f-4a1b-9c2d-3e4f5a6b7c8d"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t2"
fs = "ext4"
[[rule]]
label = "tagged"
path = "**"
tags = ["ssd"]
tags_mode = "strict"
domains = ["far"]
overflow = "deny"
spread_mode = "strict"

steps.query: SELECT CAST(lpath AS TEXT), rule, state FROM files
